body:
Correction of one sentence in the body of this issue, from the second read of PR #3471 (comment 7081245911 on that PR): "After #3442, each shipped post writes such an arc as a straight move or as no block, so the posted program is safe" is true only for a `.cnc` stream that keeps the true end points.

The app posts through `cnc::serialize`, which writes each position and each arc centre as whole micrometres. An arc with a chord below about 1 µm then has an end equal to its start in the stream, with the centre off the start. The guard of PR #3471 reads that record as a full turn, and each post writes a full-circle G02 / G03. So with the head 40e1baae7 of that PR, a program that the app posts is NOT safe for the arcs of this issue.

PR #3471 is a draft for that reason. Its worker changes the writer: an arc whose rounded ends are equal and whose true sweep is less than a full turn becomes a feed to its end, or no record. This issue stays open for the generators.
